rootCause: Fresh installation updated uninstall registry before creating Uninstall.exe, and did not rehash the activated directory after the stage->live rename. An absent or mutated generated executable could be published as a successful, uninstallable installation.
fixes: Generate setup-owned Uninstall.exe in the NSIS plugin directory before moving application trees.
Copy generated uninstaller into the stage and verify manifest payload, exact ownership marker, generated file size and its SHA-256 against the independent plugin source before first rename.
After activation, reverify full live manifest and trusted uninstaller SHA-256 BEFORE uninstall registry publication.
On live attestation failure, move suspect new install back to stage and restore prior backup if present; retain trees on incomplete recovery, never recursively delete user files.
Keep old working rollback executable integrity correction and other previous completed checks.
